helped.message: So, știi cjmva daca Mihai Barbu inchiriază Dacia roșie
helped.translation: So, you know what I mean if Mihai Barbu rents Dacia red
helped.direct:
@q query
  where match
    relation "sell"
    role subject "Mihai Barbu"
    role object "the red Dacia"
    polarity affirmed
  end
helped.translated:
@q query
  select ?m
  where match
    relation "rent"
    role subject "Mihai Barbu"
    role object "the red Dacia"
    role time ?m
    polarity affirmed
  end

helped.message: Fără să-l pun la socoteală pe Botond, oare cine e membru în corul de tineret?
helped.translation: Without counting Botond, who's a member of the youth choir?
helped.direct:
@q query
  select ?x
  where match
    relation "be employed by"
    role subject ?x
    role object "the tennis club"
    polarity affirmed
  end
  except ?x "Botond"
helped.translated:
@q query
  select ?x
  where match
    relation "be a member of"
    role subject ?x
    role object "the youth choir"
    polarity affirmed
  end
  except ?x "Botond"

hurt.message: I have a quick întrebare. How long did Botond cook at the Galați Philharmonic?
hurt.translation: I have a quick question. How long did Botond cook at the Galatii Philharmonic?
hurt.direct:
@q query
  select ?t
  measure duration
  where match
    relation "cook at"
    role subject "Botond"
    role object "the Galați Philharmonic"
    role time ?t
    polarity affirmed
  end
hurt.translated:
@q query
  select ?t
  measure duration
  where match
    relation "cook at"
    role subject "Botond"
    role object "the Galatii Philharmonic"
    role time ?t
    polarity affirmed
  end
